ARTPARK Innovation Summit
Monday, March 14, 2022
9:00 AM  10:00 AM

ARTPARK-IISc organised the ARTPARK Innovation Summit in March, 2022. This one-day hybrid event brings Industry, Academia and the Government under one roof to discuss important issues about the growth of the AI and Robotics ecosystem in India. The theme for last year was “Connecting the Unconnected”- and the conversations were about creating next- generation connectivity in rural areas, Health AI for Bharat, Connecting Bharat with Drones, Inclusive learning for the future and building AI and research ecosystem.
